title: Embed-on-search latency
wanted_capability: Either cache query embeddings (LRU keyed by query string + route) or fall back to BM25-first rendering while vector embedding fills async.
notes: 100-500ms per interactive query. Cache query embeddings or async-fill BM25-first.
resolution_note: Shipped the query-embedding LRU: embed::query_cache in bbox-embed — bounded (256-entry, LRU-evicting) process-wide cache keyed (provider, model, query), with debug-level hit/miss + embed-latency tracing. hybrid_search's vector lane and embed_agent_query both route through it; the bespoke AGENT_QUERY_EMBED_CACHE and the duplicated block_in_place embed code are removed. BM25-first async-fill rendering was evaluated and rejected: the whole hybrid pipeline runs synchronously on the blocking pool, and the cache removes the repeat-query cost that motivated the gap. Landed on beta/blackbox-v2.
